description: This file defines the interface `LoanChargeWritePlatformService` which provides method signatures for managing loan charges within the loan account service of the Apache Fineract project. It includes operations for adding, refunding, waiving, updating, deleting, and paying loan charges, as well as applying overdue charges.

methods.name: addLoanCharge
methods.description: Adds a new charge to a specified loan using details provided in the JsonCommand.

methods.name: loanChargeRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a specific loan charge.

methods.name: undoWaiveLoanCharge
methods.description: Reverses a waived loan charge, restoring its active status.

methods.name: updateLoanCharge
methods.description: Updates details of an existing loan charge.

methods.name: deleteLoanCharge
methods.description: Deletes a specific loan charge from the loan.

methods.name: payLoanCharge
methods.description: Records a payment made towards a loan charge, with an option to include charge ID in JSON.

methods.name: adjustmentForLoanCharge
methods.description: Adjusts the details of a loan charge, possibly correcting or changing its amount or status.

methods.name: applyOverdueChargesForLoan
methods.description: Applies overdue charges to a loan based on overdue loan schedule data.
